details:
I have encountered an oddly specific issue when binding the Index Trackpad as a Toggle Button set to gesture_toggle (for either click or touch, in my testing this didn't make a difference).

When doing this, using the newly created binding in game and then, on the opposite hand of the gesture_toggle being bound, rapidly opening and then closing the udon menu will cause the binding you just used on the opposite hand to be triggered.

I have tried replicating the same behavior with other toggle functions, however it seems as if this issue only occurs when using the index trackpad as a gesture toggle. I have ensured that I am editing the latest VRChat default bindings in SteamVR, and not using any pre-existing binding configurations. 

Steps for recreating the issue: 

1: Edit the default bindings for VRChat and add a binding to the index trackpad (see image attachment). The binding can be on only one hand, or both.

2: In game, use the new binding once

3: on the opposite hand of the binding that was just interacted with, quickly open and close udon menu

4: the gesture toggle binding will be triggered.

Additionally, I have disabled all 3rd Party SteamVR integrations (such as OVR Advanced settings, XSOverlay etc) to exclude the possibility of any interference. I am on the SteamVR Stable branch (Build ID 15141130), and have verified the integrity of all files of both VRChat and SteamVR.
title: [1486] SteamVR Index trackpad binded as gesture_toggle causes issues with udon menu
